anchor: Exact C163 fixed-final head already bound by independently rerun C166 arithmetic.
active_rule: All84 retained; every original C165 R>0 row active (safety0.0018), including zero gradients. No failed-state-only subset.
subspace: Original C165 symmetric-probe free mask abs(anchor)<=0.125-1e-5; 216 coordinates; no new one-sided or full-parameter claim.
linear_problem: max t subject to (raw_projected_gradient_i / stored_positive_L2_norm_i) dot d + t <= 0 for all active i; ||d||infinity<=1, excluded coordinates zero. Zero gradients are zero rows. Solver uses binary64 normalization; independent certificate uses exact rational division of original binary64 gradient by original binary64 norm.
dual: min sum(z) subject to -z<=A.T lambda<=z, lambda>=0,sum(lambda)=1,z>=0. One separate fixed dual LP; no head or checkpoint search.

solver.handling: Final primal direction clipped to declared [-1,1] bounds only; no head clipping. Final dual weights clipped nonnegative then normalized exactly as rational numbers. Both raw solver results retained. No fallback/restart/solver selection.

certificate: Fractions from exact binary64 values. Verify all84 raw response/guard dot products; exact lower=min(-B_i dot d), exact upper=sum_j abs(sum_i lambda_i*B_ij). These bound the optimal common margin for B=raw_i/exact_norm_i. Positive lower proves strict common descent for recorded active gradients; exactly zero dual upper proves no strict common descent in this subspace; otherwise unresolved. Interval width is reported, no near-zero infeasibility threshold.
outputs: All84 gradients, both LPs, exact normalized problem bounds and raw row contractions, one direction witness only, matrix/anchor/free-mask hashes. No parameter head, physical proposal or model evaluation.
scope: Offline two-LP direction diagnostic on exact binary64 archived scalar gradients. Rational verification certifies only the stated linear problem on recorded gradients in the original C165 two-sided coefficient subspace. It does not certify true model derivatives, finite-step endpoint acceptance, guard preservation, excluded-input generalisation, global feasibility or infeasibility, chronology or LC2 closure. No model, backward, new head, finite probe, training, confirmation or excluded input; original C165/C166 decisions retained.
